confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparables, not from live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and dorm anchors are the steadier values. Hotel rates assume July low season and are less certain. Cocktail and wine are set partly from the local price relationship to draught beer because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX value comes from a search summary citing the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not open that page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to the supplied Phnom Penh comparables for Cambodian restaurant and dorm levels, adjusted for Siem Reap being a tourist hub with cheaper local eateries and guesthouses but Western-priced cafes and bars. Chiang Mai and Kuala Lumpur were used only as outer bounds for hotel and mid-range levels.
